scope: Proposition 5.12 (Replica information budgets) of the manuscript “Critical local smoothing for the three-dimensional wave equation” (preprints/Critical-local-smoothing-for-the-three-dimensional-wave-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 079 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79299093c07ea305), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 70. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: At almost every interior admissible root there are arbitrarily small tangent gaps with sufficiently accurate preceding experiments such that, for any fixed finite collection of queries, Iδ(F≤p′ ; Ξ | C∗) = o(1). (vb) Define a fiber read Qi, at a sufficiently large finite depth relative to still finer stored marks, by binning B + θiX, Y + θiX2 , D′ 0 + θiN, ( P − 2riX, N − PX + riX2, quadratic, N − riX, linear. Then Iδ(X≤p′ ; Qi, Ξ | C∗) = o(1), iδ(X≤p′ | C∗) = m(a, v)p′ + o(1) in probability. (fib) At a fixed boundary root with one observation, only the consequence of (ng) for adding that observation and its fiber read is asserted; neither (vb) nor an interior angular trace is asserted there.
